text:
```yaml
name: Stale PRs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Runs daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/stale@v9
        with:
          days-before-pr-stale: 15
          days-before-pr-close: 7
          stale-pr-label: stale
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been marked as stale because it has been inactive for 15 days. If you still want to keep it open, please comment or add a label.
          close-pr-message: |
            Closing this pull request because it has been inactive for 7 days after being marked as stale.
          exempt-pr-labels: pinned,work-in-progress,on-hold
          days-before-issue-stale: -1
          days-before-issue-close: -1
```
